androidBaseline.androidThreadPolicy: max(2, min(4, online CPU count - 2)); runtime count is device-dependent
androidBaseline.grammar:
root ::= "{\"facts\":[" fact-list "]}"
fact-list ::= | fact ("," fact)*
fact ::= "{\"field\":" field ",\"value\":" string ",\"evidence\":" string "}"
field ::= "\"product_name\"" | "\"brand\"" | "\"quantity\"" | "\"abv_percent\""
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | "\\" (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})

hostRuntime.performanceComparison: host GPU measurements are reported separately and must not be compared directly with Android CPU timings

evaluation.eligibleCaseRule: reviewed_product + complete frozen source + at least one page + independently reviewed source-supported labels
evaluation.syntheticCases: never sent to the model in local quality-evaluation mode
evaluation.rawPromptOrResponsePersistence: Only in caller-selected local prompt-job/results files; never in summary reports or source control
